Payments.unavailable: PromptPay instructions are unavailable. Contact the artist or administrator before paying.
Payments.failed: The action could not be completed. Your input has been kept. Try again.
Payments.stepScan: Scan the QR with your banking app, or import the downloaded image.
Payments.stepCheck: Check the recipient returned by your bank and the exact amount before confirming the transfer.
Payments.stepUpload: Upload the transfer slip below. The artist or an administrator will review it manually.
Payments.manualWarning: DICE does not verify payments with a bank. Scanning a QR or uploading a slip does not mark this invoice paid.
Payments.irrevocableWarning: There is no bank-enforced QR expiry. Cancelling an invoice in DICE cannot revoke a QR image you have already downloaded. Do not pay a cancelled or already paid invoice.
Payments.pendingReview: Proof submitted — awaiting manual review. Do not transfer again.
Payments.uploadProof: Upload payment slip (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 15 MB)
Payments.settingsExplanation: Configure one platform recipient. Import a mobile-number PromptPay QR or enter its registered number. Confirm the account owner before enabling payments.
Payments.importHelp: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Only mobile-number PromptPay QR codes are supported. The image is decoded locally on this server and is not stored.
Payments.importedReview: Recipient number read. Review the number and enter the correct recipient name, then save. Settings have not changed yet.
Payments.importFailed: The QR could not be read. Use a clear mobile-number PromptPay QR image.
Payments.feePercent: Platform fee percentage for new orders (0–100, up to two decimal places)
Payments.invalidFee: Enter a fee between 0 and 100 with at most two decimal places.
Payments.freezeExplanation: New orders freeze the current fee. Existing orders keep their previous rate. Existing invoice instructions keep their original recipient and amount even after settings change.
Payments.saved: Payment settings saved. Existing invoice instructions remain unchanged.
Payments.ledgerExplanation: Approved invoice totals include historical payments with unknown recipients. Only explicit platform collection receipts count toward payout. Collected client funds are not money already paid to the artist. Payouts are available only for completed, fully paid orders.
Payments.payoutProof: Transfer proof (JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 15 MB)
Payments.externalTransferWarning: DICE records a transfer you have already performed outside the application. This does not send money. The settlement is permanent; refunds, reversals and corrections require a future adjustment workflow.
Payments.confirmExternalTransfer: I have completed the external transfer and checked the artist, amount, reference and proof.
Payments.payoutRecorded: Completed external transfer recorded. The selected orders cannot be settled again.

states.CANCELLED_MANUAL_RESOLUTION: Cancelled — collected funds need manual resolution
states.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Waiting for completion and full payment

PayoutRequests.title: Payout requests
PayoutRequests.explanation: Requests reserve eligible whole orders. An administrator transfers outside DICE and records evidence; DICE does not send money.
PayoutRequests.distinction: Request submitted ≠ transfer recorded ≠ receipt confirmed.
PayoutRequests.detailsWarning: Use your account-holder name and mobile-linked PromptPay number. QR import reads the number only; it does not verify account ownership. Pending requests retain their original details.
PayoutRequests.importQr: Import recipient from QR (optional, PNG/JPG/WebP, up to 5 MB)
PayoutRequests.imported: Number read. Check the recipient and save your details. Ownership is not verified.
PayoutRequests.eligibility: Completed and fully paid orders with recorded platform collections and positive net are available automatically, unless already requested or settled.
PayoutRequests.freezeWarning: These receiving details and totals are frozen when submitted. To change the recipient, cancel while requested and submit a new request.
PayoutRequests.requestOnly: Submitting this request does not transfer money.
PayoutRequests.submitted: Request submitted. No transfer has been recorded.
PayoutRequests.frozenDetails: Snapshot at submission. Profile edits do not change this destination or these totals.
PayoutRequests.qrWarning: Check the receiving name and amount in your bank app before transferring. Displaying or downloading this QR does not transfer money. Previously downloaded QR codes cannot be revoked by DICE.
PayoutRequests.transferConfirmation: I have already transferred this exact net amount outside DICE to the frozen recipient, and checked the evidence. This records a manual transfer, not bank verification.
PayoutRequests.noTransfer: I confirm that no transfer was made for this request.
PayoutRequests.failed: Unable to complete this action. Your input is preserved. Refresh the status before retrying.

actionHelp.claim: Only the claiming administrator may record the transfer. This action does not send money.
actionHelp.release: Release only if no transfer occurred. Downloaded QR codes remain usable; coordinate with other administrators before releasing.
actionHelp.cancel: Cancel this unclaimed request and make its orders available again. Its history is retained.
actionHelp.reject: Provide a reason. Orders become available for a new request; history is retained.
actionHelp.transfer: Transfer outside DICE first, then record the reference and proof once. This settlement is immutable; corrections require a separate future adjustment workflow.
actionHelp.confirm: Confirm only after receiving the money. This acknowledges receipt and does not trigger another transfer.
actionHelp.problem: Describe the issue for the administrator. This keeps the original transfer intact and does not request an additional transfer.
actionHelp.note: Record the resolution here. Only the artist can confirm receipt. Do not record another payout for the same orders.
